# P34.39b — first-fire read-backs + camreg peel-on, clock-guarded

**Requirement ids cited (context, not owned):** SIG-ENG-042 (a scheduled
check that measured nothing fails) · SIG-OPS-011 (probe-run records) ·
SIG-MEM-011 (status layers) · ADR-107/111 (timeout + stop-and-preserve).
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/248_P34.39b__first-fire-read-backs.md`
(manifest row 248, Round 11 / P34, sub-round 11A) · **Base:**
`r11/P34.39a-osm-replay-read-back` (stacked, H2 PR-1) · **Gate:** none —
read-only monitoring; no operator go needed · **Live stage:** three
read-only, clock-guarded legs — **L1** the first-fire wave's fleet
table (window closes `2026-10-21T06:09Z`), **L2** the `camreg_peel_on`
first fire on/after `2026-10-29T12:00Z`, **L3** a final read after L2.
On 2026-10-07 no leg's window is open — all three live guard runs
exited **42** (queued, not failed), so all three are **queued** in
RETURN PASS with the verbatim re-run prompt · **Production
mutations:** none — every gather is a permitted read (`gcloud
scheduler jobs list`, `gcloud run jobs executions list`, GCS
`ops/runs` list/download, a `READ ONLY` SQL session). It never
re-executes, never cancels, never writes · **OM-20:** not an OM-20
row · **CI config changed:** no.

## Why

P34.35/P34.36 rolled the scheduled-ingest fleet: 33 triggers whose
**first fire** lands 2026-10-01 → 2026-10-21T06:09Z (G1 §7.1), plus the
`camreg_peel_on` first fire P34.38 queued for 10-29. D-P31.4-1's parent
obligation needs each fire read back honestly — the fleet table, the
named reads, and the routing rows that turn failures into DEFERRALS
entries — without any leg blocking the chain.

## What ships

- **`sig-ops scheduled-firstfire --leg l1|l2|l3`**
  (`ops/src/ops/scheduled_firstfire.py` + the `cli.py` verb) — joins
  repo `cadence.toml` (78 fleet rows) to the live `scheduler jobs
  list`; derives each trigger's first fire (the earliest of the
  deploy-basis candidate and the `lastAttemptTime`-mapped fire — a
  re-pointed trigger keeps its true first fire); evaluates each
  in-scope fire (execution, WORM run rows, `ingest_run_completion`,
  verdict, routing) into the fleet table.
- **Leg guards (AR-4)** — L1 opens when the wave closes; L2/L3 hold the
  peel-on fire's `fire + lastAttemptTime + finished execution` (the
  shared `guard_failures`). Before a leg's window opens: exit `42`
  with the verbatim re-run prompt — verified **live ×3** on
  2026-10-07 (`docs/build/reports/p34.39b-first-fire-read-backs/`).
- **Named reads** — `sam_gov` @ `2026-10-01T05:00Z`
  (`D-FEDERAL.1-1`; `quota_reached` starvation evidence recorded
  verbatim) and `muckrock` @ `2026-10-01T06:00Z` (`D-FEDERAL.1-2`).
- **Routing rows** — missed/disabled/absent triggers →
  `P35.1a/P35.1b` (fleet hygiene); failed executions / `error` run
  rows → the source's connector owner (credential-shaped details →
  the operator); missing WORM rows / completions → `P31.2 / P35.1b`;
  non-zero spine `n_tup_upd`/`n_tup_del` → `stop and preserve`.
  Evidence not yet collected lands `not_evaluable` — never `fail`,
  never a fabricated green.
- **Fixture replay** — `--fixtures-dir` replays recorded scheduler /
  execution / run-row / completion captures into the identical report
  shape (`layer: fixture`, never a live record), offline.
- **D-P31.4-1 stays OPEN** — `obligation-event/1` `D-P31.4-1:e2`
  (OPEN→OPEN) records the progress note; the legs queue in RETURN
  PASS, non-blocking (`live:` edges: none in or out).

## Boundaries

Nothing is executed, cancelled or written: the command holds only
read-only calls and queues before each leg's window opens (it queued —
live, exit 42, ×3). No `ingestion_permitted` flip, no `HG-nn` tick, no
spine UPDATE/DELETE, no CI config change, no DEFERRALS lead-token
change (D-P31.4-1 stays OPEN — OPEN→OPEN progress event only),
`db/sqitch.plan` L44–52 untouched. The legs' re-run is
`implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/248_P34.39b__first-fire-read-backs.md
live_verification=true` (scope: one leg per run — l1, then l2, then l3).

_Size deviation disclosed:_ the change runs ≈ 1,591 lines
(module 992 + cli 120 + tests 455 + cadence_window 24) against the S
budget's ≤1,500 — the fleet-table evaluation surface (33 triggers ×
per-fire verdicts × routing × three legs × fixture replay) does not
shrink without cutting checks the contract lists. Recorded in the run
ledger's gap table (the P34.39a precedent: disclosed, not red).
